newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed in limited trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed in limited trade.

text.p: Indian Gujarat cotton extended its gains on Monday while little activity was observed in Punjab varieties, dealers said.
"Gujarat cotton was up due to thin supplies coupled with stray mill buying," a dealer said.
In spot deals, Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) rose 500 rupees to 13,200/13,300 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while Wagad cotton gained 300/400 rupees to 11,500 rupees per candy.
Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,660/1,700 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and so was Bengal-deshi at 825/850 rupees per maund in dull trade. --Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
